scope: Read-only source/historical evidence audit; no chip build or electrical qualification run by this audit

workarounds.title: Filtered cells
workarounds.operation: Exclude asynchronous/latch/tristate and high-risk cells including MX2101 from working Liberty copies.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Poly-pin cell exclusions
workarounds.operation: Default FORCE exclusions avoid cells whose pins require vias over poly. ALLOW_VIA_OVER_POLY is a reviewed opt-out, not a waiver.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: ABC buffer and timing option
workarounds.operation: Keep DELBUF so ABC has a buffer. Avoid incompatible abc -D constraint timing on pinned Yosys0.33.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Physical constant ties
workarounds.operation: Map constants through VDDCON/TIEHI and VSSCON/TIELO before routing.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: LEF width utilization
workarounds.operation: Use LEF widths and row budgets instead of interpreting Liberty area as square micrometres.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Working abstract grid
workarounds.operation: Change CORE site and metal1 pitch to4.2um and snap RECT coordinates to0.005um in working LEF only.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Abstract width rounding
workarounds.operation: Round non-filler widths upward to4.2um sites and add a site when a remainder would leave an illegal small gap.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Missing metal1 obstruction
workarounds.operation: Read real GDS metal1 and add geometry absent from the shipped LEF to working obstruction views.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Metal2 pin straps
workarounds.operation: Trace connected GDS metal2 through cell vias into signal pins and rebuild remaining metal2 as obstruction.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Hidden material via keepouts
workarounds.operation: Add via1 obstructions for contact, shrunk poly and diffusion edges with defined signal-pin access openings.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: MX201B matched offset
workarounds.operation: Shift MX201B5.2um within50.4um abstract and use the identical GDS placement/checker offset to put its pins on tracks.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Separated unmirrored rows
workarounds.operation: Replace default placement rows with spaced R0 rows because Y-only site symmetry does not permit alternating abutted supply rails.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Track and pin alignment
workarounds.operation: Use4.2um metal1/metal2 grids with profile offsets and assembly-matched pin positions.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Reserve rail metal
workarounds.operation: Block routing over row rail regions that assembly draws continuously through cell gaps.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: NND301 left padding
workarounds.operation: Reserve one left site on NND301 to avoid the known AND201-to-NND301 boron-width failure.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Tested filler pattern
workarounds.operation: Use FILLER2 every4.2um plus continuous rails and FILLER2/FILLER4 in the MX201B left gap. Do not substitute arbitrary shipped fillers.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Explicit stronger output drivers
workarounds.operation: Keep and lock INVR04 near OPAD04 rather than use the document INVR02 suggestion. Double inversion preserves port polarity; modeled capacitance motivates the change.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Input buffering
workarounds.operation: When REPAIR is enabled insert DELBUF on data inputs and repair slew/capacitance; preserve clock exception and check actual pad loading.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Clock buffer choice
workarounds.operation: Use noninverting CDRI01 instead of the supplied template inverter. Clock-buffer capacitance/fanout interpretations remain explicit limitations.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: Tool-compatible script names
workarounds.operation: Copy OpenROAD Tcl entries into working directories and invoke relative names. Embedded Yosys/Tcl path text still needs staging.
workarounds.verification_scope: Historical/reference evidence only; not generic electrical or foundry qualification

workarounds.title: CTS gate disconnect
workarounds.operation: Disconnect non-DFF loads from clk during CTS then reconnect to the root. Future use requires an S8-only structural before/after check.

reference_run_risks.detail: Wrappers print child tool exits without propagating them; run_all.sh pipes stages without pipefail. Validate positive outputs and every child process.
Exhausted route retries lack a hard failure. Require a current accepted route_try.txt, successful last attempt, complete zero-violation report and zero validated overlaps.
Simulation output/model paths and shell interpreter/checker paths derive from HOME. Use explicit recorded private-HOME/model/tool links or a copy-only path adapter, preserving existing results.
Embedded Yosys, SBY and SPICE path text is not made safe by argument arrays. Use a retained original-to-staged map and tool-compatible private paths.
Empty marker XML categories can currently be summarized as zero violations. Require expected nonempty executed-rule coverage.
Current CDL regex conversion ignores continuous assign aliases. Generic reuse needs structured connectivity or a rigorously validated input boundary.
P&R hard-codes clk/100ns/1pF core loads while chip STA uses separate period/external loads. Record baseline assumptions; unified constraint propagation is a later implementation gate.
RAM run_one parses vvp stdout but discards vvp returncode. Positive case summaries and specifically detected timing violations remain mandatory; later adapter must retain process codes.
